Cheezy Garlic

Allergen Call Out: Wheat, Milk

Pre-bake ingredients, bottom to top

  1. 1 ea. Pizza Dough Ball [BOOM 0101]
  2. 170 g Grande Cheese Shredded Mozzarella
  3. 150 g Pizza Sauce [BOOM 0002], applied in dots
  4. 25 g Garlic Oil [BOOM 0107]
  5. 20 g Shaved Garlic

Post bake, in order

  1. 4 g Basil
  2. 2 g Grated Romano Cheese
